aboutMore: second paragraph bc kitty says i only talk about nate (i dont) (ok i do) (here r other things). my corolla is named Leonard (leopard + leonard, mis named him). i volunteer saturdays at the animal shelter n i walk the OLD dogs bc nobody walks the old dogs. my mom works the deli at publix n gives me sub advice AND life advice at the same time, in the same breath. i make mix cds. like a LOT. each one has a tracklist n a theme n a leopard sticker on the case. if u get a mix cd from me ur officially in. <3

blog.title: the rules for riding in leonard (the corolla) (posted on the visor too)
blog.body: 1. the DRIVER picks the music. always. even if the driver is crying. especially if the driver is crying. 2. shotgun picks the 2nd song. misery is shotgun. we've talked about BMTH. we've talked a lot. 3. NO hairspray w/ the windows up. (mis.) (every time.) 4. no teasing hair while driving. kitty's rat tail comb is in the cupholder n is not allowed to leave it. 5. nobody touches the leopard steering wheel cover w/ sticky fingers. it is the only leopard in my life that has never let me down. 6. EVERYBODY screams the bridge. thats not a rule its a law. 7. if leonard stalls, we sing to him so he doesnt feel left out. it works. i believe in this completely. 8. nobody sits in the middle. the seatbelt in the middle hasnt worked since last easter n i cant take that on. leonard has 142,000 miles on him. we counted at a red light. every mile had a song. 9. whoever is crying in the passenger seat gets a free sub. its not a rule, its a mom rule. i got it from my mom.

blog.title: how to make a mix cd (the rules) (from someone who has made 71)
blog.body: ok everyone keeps asking so. 1. TRACK 1 MUST BE LOUD. u have 11 seconds to make someone look up. 2. track 2 is the 'ok relax' track. 3. theme first. a mix has to be ABOUT something. 'songs for driving at 4pm.' 'songs for the 2nd week of october.' 'songs that sound like a hug.' if u dont have a theme its just a playlist n i dont make those. 4. 18 tracks MAX (80 minutes, thats the disc, thats physics). 5. TRACK 7 is the one that makes u look out the window. nobody is allowed to skip track 7. thats the heart of the cd. 6. the LAST track is the 'u know who u are' track. 7. burn it SLOW. 4x. if u burn at 52x it skips n the skip is always on track 7. 8. write the tracklist w/ a sharpie, NOT a pen, pens smear n u look like u dont care. 9. leopard sticker on the case. its not optional. 10. never trust a limewire file. u know who u are. a song called 'sugar were goin down' turned out to be a man reading a dentists receipt for 3 min. i played it in leonard for kitty. she said it was 'art.'

blog.title: saturday at the shelter (chester got to the 3rd tree) (i cried in the parking lot)
blog.body: ok so every saturday i volunteer at the animal shelter in the senior wing. old dogs only. nobody walks the old dogs bc theyre slow n they stop a lot n sometimes they just sit down in the grass n look at u like 'i'm good here.' there is a dog named chester. hes 13, basset-ish, w/ cloudy eyes n a white chin, n hes been there 119 days. every saturday we walk to the second tree. he sits. thats it. thats the whole walk. today i went 'ok chester' n he looked at me n got up n went to the THIRD tree. the THIRD. i dont know why. maybe it was the light. maybe he felt a breeze. i said 'good boy' like 9 times n a woman at the next kennel started clapping. i cried in the parking lot. i called my mom at work n she said 'we'll see.' which in my family is a yes w/ a delay. i have a sticky note on his kennel that says ASK ME ABOUT CHESTER. someone will. someone has to.

blog.title: advice from my mom (a list) (she works the deli at publix) (she says all of this while slicing)
blog.body: 1. 'never text on an empty stomach, baby. nobody's ever right on an empty stomach.' 2. 'a boy who takes 3 days to answer is a boy who needs a nap or a better phone. figure out which.' 3. 'cry in the car. the air conditioning is good for the face.' 4. 'pick the sub, not the argument.' 5. 'dont make a decision in a parking lot.' 6. 'love isnt a feeling, its a sandwich. u make it every day whether u feel like it or not.' (i have no notes. its perfect. its the whole thing.) 7. 'im not telling u what to do, im telling u what id do. and id eat first.' she slipped me a free sub on friday. the wrapper had a note on it in sharpie. it said 'u r a good kid. eat.' i saved the wrapper. its in the glove box, next to the napkins n a leopard pen. i dont know how to tell her i love her in a way thats as good as a sub. so i just eat it all. every bite. thats the whole system.

survey.title: the 'know ur driver' survey (kitty made me do it at a red light)
qa: car:
99 corolla. named Leonard. 142,000 miles. 90% leopard. 10% misery's hairspray fumes
worst thing in the glove box:
a fossilized french fry from the summer. i keep it as a memorial. also a leopard pen, 14 napkins, n a hair tie that isnt mine (misery's)
songs u cry to in the car:
'thnks fr th mmrs' (obviously), anything by paramore, n a song on a mix i made for a boy that i wont name. u know who. (u dont) (nate)
dog or cat:
old dog. the older the better. a dog w/ a gray chin has seen things n still wants to go for a walk. thats how i want to be
worst driving moment:

failed my first driving test. i parallel parked on a cone. i told the examiner 'leonard is leopard and cannot be wrong.' he gave me a 74. i passed the 2nd time w/ a 92. i have the cone. its on my shelf. its named cornelius
something about u ppl dont know:
i have a notebook of every dog i have ever walked at the shelter. 61 dogs. their name, age, favorite thing. i update it. one has a star next to its name. thats chester
favorite sub at publix:
chicken tender sub, mayo, pickles, no lettuce. my mom makes it. she doesnt even look. she just knows
who sits in the back seat:
kitty. she brings snacks n a comb. she also brings her own seat belt. its pink
what do u do w/ ur mixes after u burn them:
give them to whoever needs them. i dont keep any. i keep the tracklists tho. in a box. under my bed. 71 of them
last thing u cried at:
chester going to the 3rd tree. n then a commercial for a cell phone plan where a dad calls his kid. i dont know. its been a week
worst advice u ever got:
'wait by the phone.' my sidekick has a screen. u can look at it from anywhere. waiting by it is just standing next to a rock
what makes a good friend:
someone who will sing to a stalled car w/ u. thats literally the whole test
